description: Cartoon-first thumbnail brief. Separates artwork generation from typography so the image model never renders text, and records the visual hook/cast used for later CTR and watch-time analysis.

text.description: Two to five words that complement rather than repeat the title. Typography is added after image generation.

emphasis.description: Contiguous phrase copied exactly from text and rendered as the visual text focal point.

art_prompt.description: Complete 16:9 cartoon artwork prompt. Must explicitly prohibit text/logos and reserve a quiet text-safe region while keeping the emotional subject and hero object large.

visual_hook.description: One visual sentence describing the conflict/question a viewer should understand in under a second.

character_ids.description: At most two recurring cast members visible in the thumbnail.

preferred_text_side.description: Side deliberately kept visually quiet in the generated artwork. Renderer analysis remains authoritative.

alternatives.description: Two genuinely different hook-text angles retained for later YouTube title/thumbnail experiments.
